authorization: 用户睡前授权三张A100，筛查无问题后自动全量；汇报target/TF/TF+PF、trace、新tau/接受、5090速度。
preserves: all prior attempts, consumed time, fixed versions and historical flags
original small deadline; extension is a new bounded phase

small.PF: S,S,T repeated by completed policy ordinal from zero per episode

gate.scope: engineering expansion gate only, no scientific permission promotion
gate.canonical_pilot: all 4 complete and at least 3 successful; otherwise diagnose baseline before teacher training
gate.candidate_success: each S/P >= paired T success count
gate.numerics: canonical adapter and actual trained B7 serial/batch/isolation checks pass; all chunks G=10
gate.identity: same physical init, seeds, protocol and hardware per matched arms; pixels recorded and differences explicitly analyzed, not overwritten
gate.failure: no automatic full launch if gate fails; retain negatives and diagnose within registered scope

conditional_full.other_suite_prerequisites: same fixed recipe, suite-specific FIT/CAL and 20-group triarm screen before its full queue
conditional_full.train_recipe: same 54094-parameter architecture and fixed final3000; no architecture/threshold search
conditional_full.heldout_reporting: Full official 50/init aggregate includes FIT/CAL/DEV exposure and is NOT independent TEST; strata explicitly marked
conditional_full.robotwin: separate checkpoint/stats and official environment contract first; no LIBERO weight reuse, no unseen/seen protocol substitution
